description: This file defines data models and query parameter classes related to ESG sector information, including classes for querying ESG data by year and for representing ESG sector data with various scores.

classes.name: ESGSectorQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for fetching ESG sector data, specifically a 'year' parameter.

classes.name: ESGSectorData
classes.description: Represents ESG sector data including year, sector name, and various scores (environmental, social, governance, overall ESG).

methods.name: ESGSectorData
methods.description: Constructor for ESGSectorData; initializes data fields: year, sector, environmental_score, social_score, governance_score, esg_score.
